Evidence supports testing multi-negative cross-entropy, but does not establish that easy negatives caused Electronics’ weakness. [Wu et al., TOIS 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.02327) show sampled softmax implicitly emphasizes high-scoring negatives; temperature controls this emphasis. Their experiments favor cosine scoring during training but inner products during inference, highlighting that normalization can discard useful magnitude information. These results concern general recommendation and need verification in SASRec. [Scalable Cross-Entropy, RecSys 2024](https://dspace.mit.edu/entities/publication/5392aca9-0bae-4176-9b3a-a8165957ba26) instead approximates softmax using maximum-inner-product retrieval of informative catalog items—an alternative to increasing uniform samples, with additional implementation and runtime costs.

Harder negatives introduce ambiguity: unobserved items may be relevant. The [2026 negative-sampling survey](https://doi.org/10.1145/3793855) documents false-negative risks and distinguishes dynamic mining from importance reweighting. Hardness alone cannot establish irrelevance. [Context-aware sampling, 2025](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11021640) reports diversity gains with a small accuracy loss, so it provides limited support for improving this task’s HR@10 objective. An older, directly relevant comparator is [gSASRec](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.07192): more negatives plus generalized BCE to address sampling-induced overconfidence.

Suggested controlled comparison: retain the proposed 32-uniform-negative CE baseline; separately test temperature-scaled normalized scoring, a uniform/semi-hard mixture, and 32-negative gBCE. Mask padding, target collisions and known training positives; do not use held-out interactions to identify false negatives. Treat semi-hard filtering as a hypothesis, not verified relevance detection. Keep architecture, seeds and training budget comparable; select exclusively by pinned four-category macro validation HR@10, recording category results and GPU time. Electronics margins and embedding alignment remain diagnostic associations, not causal evidence.
